mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines over three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) YoY growth is below 2%, it signals a tight monetary policy with controlled inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with controlled inflation
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in a month, it signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST decreases by more than 10% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% and Industrial Production (INDPRO) growth is below 0.5% YoY, it signals a supply-side slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 1% and INDPRO growth < 0.5% YoY
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth is below 1% and INDPRO growth is below 0.5% YoY.
